item.title: muNDa-non-steppe
item.description:
Source: RK

there is R1a penetration among tribals. the great exception here are todas.

look at munda. almost no steppe or r1a. dravidian tribals have both to some extent.

The munda are a counter-culture to the aryan-steppe patrlineage conquest system. They either resisted successfully or were exterminated. read their myths. They’re alien to India. the irony of calling them indigenous is they are profoundly other. 100% austroasiatic men, probably from the kra isthmus. Evidence they used to occupy lowlands, driven up.

item.title: Santal mahiShAsura
item.description:
Source: TW

Christian Propaganda Alert 🚨

Did you know?

The concept of Mahishasur being ancestors of santhal(Tribal) was first started by a Norwegian missionary named Lars Olsen Skrefsrud in his book Horkoren Mare Hapramko Reak Katha in 1871.

Who was Lars Skrefsrud?

He was a petty thief, who was convicted & was in prison in Oslo.

To escape his criminal record, he became a Christian & joined missionary work of proselytism.

He was formally trained into evangelism
